nodes.summary: There is a real number $C > 0$ such that the set of all sums $\sum_{(k, l) \in B} 2^k 3^l$, where $B$ is a nonempty finite set of pairs of natural numbers such that $\max_{(k, l) \in B} 2^k 3^l \le C \min_{(k, l) \in B} 2^k 3^l$, does not have natural density $0$.
nodes.title: Erdős Problem 845 is false

nodes.summary: The proposition asserts that for every real number $C > 0$, the set of all sums $\sum_{(k, l) \in B} 2^k 3^l$, where $B$ is a nonempty finite set of pairs of natural numbers such that $\max_{(k, l) \in B} 2^k 3^l \le C \min_{(k, l) \in B} 2^k 3^l$, has natural density $0$.
